title.narrative: The Livelihoods and Food and Security Fund (LIFT) II

description.narrative:
The planned effect on society (Impact) is ”to strengthen the food security and livelihoods of poor and vulnerable groups to recover from and to withstand variable shocks and stressors.” which is the purpose of LIFT.
The planned effects for the target group of the Programme (Outcome) are: - Nutritional status of vulnerable households improved, with emphasis on women and children - To contribute to sustaining or increasing improved and gender-responsive livelihood strategies - Increase community resilience by supporting gender-responsive and inclusive risk management, social protection, and social cohesion
The main planned outputs of the Programme (Outputs) are: - Food system actors are supported to sustainably increase food production - People are supported to improve their physical, social and financial access to food - People are supported to adopt improved nutrition and WASH practices and behaviours through nutrition-related services and SBCC - People are supported to start or improve their enterprises or employment opportunities - People are supported with access to inclusive social protection, protection and safe migration services - Local actors' capacity to support locally-led systems is strengthened
